grammarNoteTr: come/go/get + back: geri gelmek, geri gitmek, dönmek

senses.label: return
senses.definitionEn: to the place or state where someone or something was before

examples.en: I'll be back in ten minutes.
examples.noteTr: be back: geri dönmek, dönmüş olmak.

examples.en: She went back to her hometown after university.
Can you call me back when you are free?
examples.tr: Müsait olduğunda beni geri arayabilir misin?
examples.noteTr: call someone back: birini geri aramak.

senses.label: body part
senses.definitionEn: the part of your body behind you, from your neck down to your waist

examples.en: My back hurts after sitting at the desk all day.
examples.tr: Bütün gün masada oturduktan sonra sırtım ağrıyor.

examples.en: He was lying on his back and looking at the stars.

commonMistakesTr: "Hiç sorum yok" için "I don't have no questions" denmez; olumsuz cümlede "any" kullanılır: I don't have any questions.
grammarNoteTr: Soru ve olumsuz cümlelerde: any + çoğul/sayılamayan isim

senses.label: some or none, in questions
senses.definitionEn: used in questions and negative sentences to talk about an amount or number of something, even a small one

examples.en: Do you have any brothers or sisters?
examples.tr: Hiç erkek ya da kız kardeşin var mı?

examples.en: There isn't any milk left in the fridge.
You can call me at any time of the day.
examples.tr: Günün herhangi bir saatinde beni arayabilirsin.
examples.noteTr: Olumlu cümlede "any" = herhangi bir, fark etmez.

commonMistakesTr: "Matematikte iyiyim" için "I'm good in maths" değil "I'm good at maths" denir.
grammarNoteTr: good at + isim/-ing: bir şeyde iyi olmak

senses.label: of high quality
senses.definitionEn: pleasant, of a high standard, or done well

examples.en: That was a really good film.
She is very good at drawing animals.
Is it a good idea to leave so early?
examples.tr: Bu kadar erken çıkmak iyi bir fikir mi?

commonMistakesTr: Çoğulu "womans" değil, "women" /ˈwɪmɪn/ olur.
grammarNoteTr: Düzensiz çoğul: woman → women

senses.label: adult female
senses.definitionEn: an adult female person

examples.en: A woman at the station helped me with my bags.
examples.tr: İstasyondaki bir kadın çantalarımı taşımama yardım etti.

examples.en: Three women are waiting outside the office.
The company is run by a young woman from Izmir.
examples.tr: Şirketi İzmirli genç bir kadın yönetiyor.

commonMistakesTr: "through" (içinden geçerek) ile "across" (bir yüzeyin bir yanından öbürüne) karıştırılır: walk through the forest, walk across the road.
grammarNoteTr: through + yer: bir şeyin bir ucundan girip öbüründen çıkmak

senses.label: from one side to the other
senses.definitionEn: from one end or side of something to the other, by going inside it

examples.en: We drove through a long tunnel under the mountain.
examples.tr: Dağın altındaki uzun bir tünelden geçtik.

examples.en: The cat came in through the open window.
I walked through the park on my way home.

commonMistakesTr: "Bizimle" için "with we" değil "with us" denir; fiil ve edattan sonra "us" gelir.
grammarNoteTr: Nesne zamiri: we (özne) → us (nesne)

senses.label: object form of we
senses.definitionEn: used as the object of a verb or preposition to mean the speaker and one or more other people

examples.en: Can you help us with these boxes?
examples.tr: Bu kutular için bize yardım edebilir misin?

examples.en: Our teacher gave us a lot of homework.
Why don't you come to the cinema with us?

commonMistakesTr: Çoğulu "lifes" değil "lives" olur.
grammarNoteTr: Çoğul: life → lives

senses.label: being alive
senses.definitionEn: the time between being born and dying, or the experience of being alive

examples.en: She has lived in this town all her life.
examples.tr: Bütün hayatı boyunca bu kasabada yaşadı.
examples.noteTr: all her life: bütün hayatı boyunca.

examples.en: City life can be noisy and stressful.
examples.tr: Şehir hayatı gürültülü ve stresli olabilir.

examples.en: Doctors save many lives every day.
examples.tr: Doktorlar her gün birçok hayat kurtarır.

commonMistakesTr: Çoğulu "childs" değil "children" olur.
grammarNoteTr: Düzensiz çoğul: child → children

senses.label: young person
senses.definitionEn: a young person who is not yet an adult

examples.en: As a child, I loved climbing trees.
They have two children and a dog.
examples.tr: İki çocukları ve bir köpekleri var.

examples.en: Every child in the class got a small gift.
examples.tr: Sınıftaki her çocuk küçük bir hediye aldı.

commonMistakesTr: Ders çalışmak için "work" yerine "study" kullanılır: I study for the exam.
grammarNoteTr: work for + şirket; work as + meslek

senses.label: do a job
senses.definitionEn: to do a job, especially to earn money

examples.en: My father works in a hospital.
I worked for a bank before I moved here.
examples.tr: Buraya taşınmadan önce bir bankada çalıştım.

examples.en: Do you work from home on Fridays?

senses.label: function
senses.definitionEn: to operate correctly or to have the result you want

examples.en: The lift isn't working again.
I tried a new plan, and it worked!
examples.tr: Yeni bir plan denedim ve işe yaradı!

grammarNoteTr: Fiil + down: sit down (oturmak), write down (not almak)

senses.label: toward a lower place
senses.definitionEn: from a higher place or position to a lower one

examples.en: Please sit down and make yourself comfortable.
The children ran down the hill.
Can you write down your phone number for me?
examples.tr: Telefon numaranı benim için yazar mısın?

commonMistakesTr: "may"den sonra "to" gelmez: "May I to go?" değil "May I go?" denir.
grammarNoteTr: may + yalın fiil

senses.label: possibility
senses.definitionEn: used to say that something is possible

examples.en: It may rain later, so take an umbrella.
He may not know about the meeting.
We may visit my aunt this weekend.
examples.tr: Bu hafta sonu teyzemi ziyaret edebiliriz.

senses.label: permission
senses.definitionEn: used to ask for or give permission politely

examples.en: May I open the window?
You may leave when you finish the test.

commonMistakesTr: Cümle sonunda "sonra" anlamında "after" değil "later" kullanılır: I'll call you later.
grammarNoteTr: after + isim / -ing / cümle

senses.label: later than
senses.definitionEn: later than a time or event

examples.en: Let's meet for coffee after work.
examples.tr: İşten sonra kahve içmek için buluşalım.

examples.en: After dinner, we watched a film together.
examples.tr: Akşam yemeğinden sonra birlikte film izledik.

examples.en: She felt much better after sleeping for ten hours.
examples.tr: On saat uyuduktan sonra çok daha iyi hissetti.

commonMistakesTr: "should"dan sonra "to" gelmez: "You should to go" değil "You should go" denir.
grammarNoteTr: should + yalın fiil: tavsiye

senses.label: advice
senses.definitionEn: used to give advice or to say what is the right thing to do

examples.en: You should drink more water.
We shouldn't stay up so late on school nights.
examples.tr: Ertesi gün okul varken bu kadar geç saate kadar oturmamalıyız.

examples.en: What should I wear to the interview?

commonMistakesTr: "Birini aramak" için "call to someone" değil "call someone" denir: I'll call you.
grammarNoteTr: call + kişi (to almaz)

senses.label: phone
senses.definitionEn: to phone someone

examples.en: I'll call you when I get home.
Did anyone call while I was out?
She called the doctor for an appointment.

senses.label: name
senses.definitionEn: to give someone or something a name, or to use a name for them

examples.en: They called their baby Deniz.
Everyone calls him Tom, but his real name is Thomas.
examples.tr: Herkes ona Tom der, ama asıl adı Thomas.

commonMistakesTr: "Dünyada" için "in world" değil "in the world" denir.
grammarNoteTr: the world: genelde "the" ile kullanılır

senses.label: the earth
senses.definitionEn: the earth and all the people, places and things on it

examples.en: She wants to travel around the world.
examples.noteTr: around the world: dünyanın her yerinde, dünyayı dolaşarak.

examples.en: This is the tallest building in the world.
English is spoken in many parts of the world.

commonMistakesTr: "over" (üstünde, temas etmeden ya da örterek) ile "on" (üstünde, temas ederek) karıştırılır.

senses.label: above or across
senses.definitionEn: above something, or from one side of it to the other by going above it

examples.en: A small plane flew over our house.
examples.tr: Küçük bir uçak evimizin üstünden geçti.

examples.en: The dog jumped over the fence.
Put a blanket over the baby.

senses.label: more than
senses.definitionEn: more than a number or amount

examples.en: Over fifty people came to the party.
You must be over eighteen to drive here.
examples.tr: Burada araba kullanmak için on sekiz yaşından büyük olmalısın.

commonMistakesTr: Öğrenci olarak okula gitmek için "go to the school" değil "go to school" denir.
grammarNoteTr: go to school / at school: "the" kullanılmaz

senses.label: place of education
senses.definitionEn: a place where children go to learn

examples.en: My little brother started school this year.
examples.tr: Küçük kardeşim bu yıl okula başladı.

examples.en: What time do you go to school?
We had a party at school yesterday.

commonMistakesTr: "still" (hâlâ) ile "yet" (henüz) karıştırılır: He still hasn't called = Hâlâ aramadı.
grammarNoteTr: still genelde ana fiilden önce, "be" fiilinden sonra gelir

senses.label: continuing
senses.definitionEn: continuing until now, or not stopping

examples.en: Are you still living in the same flat?
It's ten o'clock and she's still asleep.
examples.tr: Saat on ve o hâlâ uyuyor.

examples.en: I still don't understand this exercise.

senses.label: not moving
senses.definitionEn: without moving or making a sound

examples.en: Please stand still while I take the photo.
The lake was so still that it looked like glass.
examples.tr: Göl o kadar durgundu ki cam gibi görünüyordu.

commonMistakesTr: "try to do" (yapmaya çalışmak) ile "try doing" (deneyip görmek) farklıdır.
grammarNoteTr: try to + fiil: çalışmak; try + -ing: denemek

senses.label: attempt
senses.definitionEn: to make an effort to do something, or to test something to see if it is good

examples.en: I'll try to finish the report by Friday.
Have you ever tried Japanese food?
He tried hard, but he couldn't open the jar.
Can I try on these shoes?

commonMistakesTr: "Geçen hafta" için "the last week" değil "last week" denir.
grammarNoteTr: last week/year/night: "the" ve "in" kullanılmaz

senses.label: most recent
senses.definitionEn: the most recent, just before the present one

examples.en: I saw her last week at the market.
Where did you go last summer?
Did you sleep well last night?

senses.label: final
senses.definitionEn: coming after all the others

examples.en: December is the last month of the year.
Who was the last person to leave the office?
examples.tr: Ofisten en son çıkan kim oldu?

commonMistakesTr: "Ona sordum" için "I asked to him" değil "I asked him" denir.
grammarNoteTr: ask + kişi; ask for + şey; ask someone to + fiil

senses.label: question or request
senses.definitionEn: to say something to get an answer, or to say that you want someone to do or give something

examples.en: Can I ask you a question?
She asked the waiter for some water.
My boss asked me to stay late tonight.
examples.tr: Patronum bu akşam geç saate kadar kalmamı istedi.

commonMistakesTr: "İhtiyacım var" için "I am need" değil "I need" denir.
grammarNoteTr: need + isim; need to + fiil

senses.label: must have
senses.definitionEn: to have to have something, or to have to do something

examples.en: I need a new phone charger.
examples.tr: Yeni bir telefon şarj aletine ihtiyacım var.

examples.en: You don't need to bring anything to the party.
examples.tr: Partiye bir şey getirmene gerek yok.

examples.en: Do you need any help with your homework?
examples.tr: Ödevin için yardıma ihtiyacın var mı?

commonMistakesTr: "too" (gereğinden fazla) ile "very" (çok) karıştırılır: It's too hot = gereğinden fazla sıcak, olumsuz anlam taşır.
grammarNoteTr: too + sıfat (+ to + fiil): ...-emeyecek kadar

senses.label: more than enough
senses.definitionEn: more than is wanted, needed or possible

examples.en: This coffee is too hot to drink.
I ate too much and now I feel sick.
examples.tr: Çok fazla yedim ve şimdi midem bulanıyor.

examples.en: The shoes were too small, so I gave them back.
examples.tr: Ayakkabılar çok küçüktü, o yüzden geri verdim.

senses.label: also
senses.definitionEn: in addition; also

examples.en: I like pizza, and my sister likes it too.
examples.tr: Ben pizzayı severim, kız kardeşim de sever.

examples.en: I'm really hungry. Me too, let's eat.
examples.tr: Çok acıktım. Ben de, hadi yiyelim.

commonMistakesTr: "Kendimi iyi hissediyorum" için "I feel myself good" değil "I feel good" denir.
grammarNoteTr: feel + sıfat; feel like + -ing: canı istemek

senses.label: experience an emotion or state
senses.definitionEn: to experience an emotion or a physical condition

examples.en: I feel much better today, thank you.
examples.tr: Bugün kendimi çok daha iyi hissediyorum, teşekkürler.

examples.en: She felt nervous before her first exam.
Do you feel like going out tonight?
examples.tr: Bu akşam dışarı çıkmak istiyor musun?

senses.label: number 3
senses.definitionEn: the number 3

examples.en: I have three cousins in Ankara.
The meeting starts at three o'clock.
We stayed there for three nights.

senses.label: condition
senses.definitionEn: the condition that someone or something is in at a particular time

examples.en: The old house was in a terrible state.
She was in no state to drive home.
The report describes the state of the economy.

senses.label: part of a country or a nation
senses.definitionEn: one of the parts that some countries such as the US are divided into, or a country with its own government

examples.en: Texas is one of the largest states in the US.
examples.tr: Teksas, ABD'nin en büyük eyaletlerinden biridir.

examples.en: The museum is paid for by the state.

commonMistakesTr: "never" zaten olumsuzdur; "I don't never eat meat" denmez: I never eat meat.
grammarNoteTr: never + fiil; ikinci bir olumsuzluk eklenmez

senses.label: not at any time
senses.definitionEn: not at any time; not once

examples.en: I have never been to London.
examples.noteTr: have never been: hiç gitmemiş olmak.

examples.en: He never eats breakfast before work.
I'll never forget that summer.

commonMistakesTr: "become" değişimi anlatır; "Öğretmen oldu" için "She was a teacher" değil "She became a teacher" denir.
grammarNoteTr: become – became – become

senses.label: start to be
senses.definitionEn: to start to be something

examples.en: She wants to become a doctor.
We became good friends at university.
The weather became colder in the evening.

commonMistakesTr: İki şey için "between", üç ve daha fazlası arasında genelde "among" kullanılır.
grammarNoteTr: between A and B: A ile B arasında

senses.label: in the middle
senses.definitionEn: in the space or time that separates two things or people

examples.en: The bank is between the café and the bookshop.
examples.noteTr: between A and B: A ile B arasında.

examples.en: I'm free between two and four o'clock.
examples.tr: Saat iki ile dört arası boşum.

examples.en: What is the difference between these two words?
examples.tr: Bu iki kelime arasındaki fark ne?

commonMistakesTr: Bina ve insan için genelde "tall", dağ, duvar ve fiyat için "high" kullanılır: a tall man, a high wall.

senses.label: far above the ground
senses.definitionEn: large in distance from the bottom to the top, or far above the ground

examples.en: The mountains here are very high.
The wall was too high to climb.
There is a high shelf above the door.
examples.tr: Kapının üstünde yüksek bir raf var.

senses.label: large amount
senses.definitionEn: greater than the usual level or amount

examples.en: Prices are very high in this part of the city.
examples.tr: Şehrin bu bölümünde fiyatlar çok yüksek.

examples.en: She got a high score on the test.

senses.label: very or truly
senses.definitionEn: very much, or used to show that something is true

examples.en: The film was really funny.
I really want to see you again.
Do you like jazz? Not really, to be honest.
examples.tr: Cazı sever misin? Pek sayılmaz, açıkçası.
examples.noteTr: not really: pek değil, pek sayılmaz.

commonMistakesTr: Olumsuz ve soru cümlelerinde genelde "anything" kullanılır: I didn't buy anything.
grammarNoteTr: something + sıfat: something cold (sıfat sonra gelir)

senses.label: a thing not named
senses.definitionEn: a thing that is not known or not named

examples.en: I want something cold to drink.
There's something in my eye.
Can I tell you something important?
examples.tr: Sana önemli bir şey söyleyebilir miyim?

commonMistakesTr: "Çoğu insan" için "the most people" değil "most people" denir.
grammarNoteTr: most + çoğul isim: çoğu; the most + sıfat: en

senses.label: the largest number or amount
senses.definitionEn: almost all, or the largest number or amount

examples.en: Most people in my town have a car.
She is the most popular girl in her class.
Most of my friends live near the sea.

commonMistakesTr: "another" tekil isimle kullanılır: another book ("another books" değil); çoğulda "other" denir.
grammarNoteTr: another + tekil isim

senses.label: one more or a different one
senses.definitionEn: one more, or a different one of the same kind

examples.en: Would you like another cup of tea?
examples.tr: Bir fincan çay daha ister misiniz?

examples.en: This shirt is too small; can I try another one?
examples.tr: Bu gömlek çok küçük; başka birini deneyebilir miyim?

examples.en: Let's talk about it another time.

commonMistakesTr: "much" sayılamayan isimlerle, "many" sayılabilen çoğul isimlerle kullanılır: much water, many bottles.
grammarNoteTr: much + sayılamayan isim; how much: ne kadar

senses.label: a large amount
senses.definitionEn: a large amount of something

examples.en: How much is this jacket?
We don't have much time before the train leaves.
examples.tr: Tren kalkmadan önce fazla vaktimiz yok.

examples.en: Thank you very much for your help.

grammarNoteTr: Çoğul: families

senses.label: relatives
senses.definitionEn: a group of people related to each other, such as parents and their children

examples.en: I'm spending the holiday with my family.
How many people are there in your family?
Many families visit the park on Sundays.
examples.tr: Pazar günleri birçok aile parkı ziyaret eder.

commonMistakesTr: "Kendi odam" için "my self room" değil "my own room" denir.
grammarNoteTr: iyelik sıfatı + own: my own, her own; on your own: tek başına

senses.label: belonging to you
senses.definitionEn: belonging to a particular person and not to anyone else

examples.en: I finally have my own room.
She started her own business last year.
Can you do this exercise on your own?
examples.tr: Bu alıştırmayı tek başına yapabilir misin?

commonMistakesTr: "Okuldan ayrılmak" için "leave from school" değil "leave school" denir.
grammarNoteTr: leave – left – left

senses.label: go away from a place
senses.definitionEn: to go away from a place or person

examples.en: What time do you leave for work?
The train left ten minutes ago.
I left school when I was eighteen.

senses.label: not take
senses.definitionEn: to let something stay in a place, often by mistake

examples.en: I think I left my keys in the car.
Please leave a message after the beep.
examples.tr: Lütfen sinyal sesinden sonra mesaj bırakın.

commonMistakesTr: put fiilinin geçmiş hâli de "put"tır; "putted" denmez.
grammarNoteTr: put – put – put

senses.label: place something
senses.definitionEn: to move something into a particular place or position

examples.en: Put your bag on the chair.
Where did you put my glasses?
She put on her coat and went outside.

senses.label: not new or not young
senses.definitionEn: having lived or existed for a long time; not new or young

examples.en: My grandfather is very old but still active.
examples.tr: Dedem çok yaşlı ama hâlâ hareketli.

examples.en: We live in an old house near the river.
examples.tr: Nehrin yakınında eski bir evde oturuyoruz.

examples.en: How old is your little sister?

commonMistakesTr: "while" ile "during" karıştırılır: while + cümle (while I was eating), during + isim (during dinner).
grammarNoteTr: while + cümle; genelde geçmiş sürekli zamanla

senses.label: during the time that
senses.definitionEn: during the time that something else is happening

examples.en: I fell asleep while I was watching TV.
Someone called while you were in the shower.
Can you hold my bag while I find my ticket?
examples.tr: Ben biletimi bulana kadar çantamı tutar mısın?

commonMistakesTr: "Ne demek istiyorsun?" için "What do you want to say?" yerine "What do you mean?" çok daha doğaldır.
grammarNoteTr: mean – meant – meant

senses.label: have a meaning
senses.definitionEn: to have or express a particular meaning

examples.en: What does this word mean?
examples.noteTr: What does X mean?: X ne demek?

examples.en: A red light means you must stop.
examples.tr: Kırmızı ışık durman gerektiği anlamına gelir.

examples.en: What do you mean by that?

senses.label: intend
senses.definitionEn: to plan or want to do something

examples.en: Sorry, I didn't mean to hurt you.
I meant to call you, but I forgot.

commonMistakesTr: "Devam etmek" anlamında keep + -ing kullanılır: keep walking ("keep to walk" değil).
grammarNoteTr: keep + -ing: yapmaya devam etmek; keep – kept – kept

senses.label: continue or have
senses.definitionEn: to continue to have something, or to continue doing something

examples.en: You can keep the book; I don't need it.
examples.tr: Kitap sende kalsın; bana lazım değil.

examples.en: Keep walking until you see the bridge.
examples.tr: Köprüyü görene kadar yürümeye devam et.

examples.en: She kept her old letters in a box.
Let's keep in touch after the course.

senses.label: someone who studies
senses.definitionEn: a person who is studying at a school, college or university

examples.en: My sister is a student at Ankara University.
There are thirty students in our class.
examples.noteTr: Sayıdan sonra İngilizcede isim çoğul olur: thirty students.

examples.en: Students get a discount at the cinema.

grammarNoteTr: Why + yardımcı fiil + özne ...?: Why are you late?

senses.label: for what reason
senses.definitionEn: for what reason

examples.en: Why are you late again?
Why don't we go to the beach tomorrow?
I don't know why she left so early.
examples.tr: Neden bu kadar erken gittiğini bilmiyorum.

examples.en: It was raining, and that's why we stayed home.
examples.tr: Yağmur yağıyordu, o yüzden evde kaldık.

commonMistakesTr: "let"ten sonra "to" gelmez: "Let me to go" değil "Let me go" denir.
grammarNoteTr: let + kişi + yalın fiil; let – let – let

senses.label: allow
senses.definitionEn: to allow someone to do something

examples.en: Let me help you with that bag.
examples.tr: O çanta için sana yardım edeyim.

examples.en: My parents didn't let me go to the concert.
Please let me know if you need anything.
examples.tr: Bir şeye ihtiyacın olursa lütfen bana haber ver.

examples.en: Let's go for a walk.

senses.label: very good
senses.definitionEn: very good or very enjoyable

examples.en: We had a great time at the festival.
examples.noteTr: have a great time: harika vakit geçirmek.

examples.en: That's a great idea, let's do it!
She is a great teacher and everyone loves her.
examples.tr: O harika bir öğretmen ve herkes onu seviyor.

commonMistakesTr: "same" neredeyse her zaman "the" ile kullanılır: the same color ("same color" değil).
grammarNoteTr: the same + isim (as ...)

senses.label: not different
senses.definitionEn: exactly like another one, or not different

examples.en: We were born in the same year.
Your bag is the same as mine.
Everyone started talking at the same time.

senses.label: large in size
senses.definitionEn: large in size, amount or importance

examples.en: They live in a big house with a garden.
Istanbul is bigger than Ankara.
examples.noteTr: big → bigger → biggest (g iki kez yazılır).

examples.en: Moving to a new country is a big decision.
examples.tr: Yeni bir ülkeye taşınmak büyük bir karardır.

senses.label: number of people or things together
senses.definitionEn: a number of people or things that are together or connected

examples.en: A group of students was waiting at the bus stop.
examples.tr: Bir grup öğrenci otobüs durağında bekliyordu.

examples.en: The teacher put us in groups of four.
Our team is the smallest group in the company.

grammarNoteTr: begin – began – begun; begin + -ing / to + fiil

senses.label: start
senses.definitionEn: to start doing something, or to start to happen

examples.en: The lesson begins at nine o'clock.
It began to rain as we left the house.
Let's begin with a short exercise.

grammarNoteTr: seem + sıfat; seem to + fiil

senses.label: appear to be
senses.definitionEn: to appear to be something or to have a particular quality

examples.en: You seem a bit tired today.
It seems that nobody knows the answer.
The new manager seems very friendly.

grammarNoteTr: Çoğul: countries; the country: kırsal bölge, taşra

senses.label: nation
senses.definitionEn: an area of land with its own government

examples.en: Which countries have you visited?
Turkey is a beautiful country with a long history.
examples.tr: Türkiye, uzun bir tarihi olan güzel bir ülke.

examples.en: He moved to another country for work.
examples.tr: İş için başka bir ülkeye taşındı.

commonMistakesTr: "Ona yardım ettim" için "I helped to him" değil "I helped him" denir.
grammarNoteTr: help + kişi (+ with + isim); help + kişi + (to) fiil

senses.label: make easier
senses.definitionEn: to make it easier for someone to do something

examples.en: Can you help me with my homework?
examples.noteTr: help + kişi + with: ... konusunda yardım etmek.

examples.en: My neighbour helped me carry the sofa.
Reading every day helps you learn new words.
examples.tr: Her gün okumak yeni kelimeler öğrenmene yardımcı olur.

commonMistakesTr: "Onunla konuştum" için "I talked him" değil "I talked to him" denir.
grammarNoteTr: talk to/with + kişi; talk about + konu

senses.label: speak
senses.definitionEn: to say things to someone in a conversation

examples.en: I need to talk to you about something.
examples.tr: Seninle bir şey hakkında konuşmam lazım.

examples.en: We talked for hours on the phone last night.
Don't talk during the exam, please.

grammarNoteTr: Where + yardımcı fiil + özne ...?: Where do you live?

senses.label: in or to what place
senses.definitionEn: in, at or to which place

examples.en: Where do you live now?
I don't remember where I parked the car.
This is the café where we first met.

commonMistakesTr: "Işığı açmak" için "open the light" değil "turn on the light" denir.
grammarNoteTr: turn on/off: (cihaz) açmak/kapatmak

senses.label: change direction
senses.definitionEn: to move so that you are facing or going in a different direction

examples.en: Turn left at the next corner.
She turned around and smiled at me.
Can you turn on the light, please?

senses.label: become
senses.definitionEn: to change and become something different

examples.en: The leaves turn yellow in autumn.
The milk turned sour in the heat.

senses.label: difficulty
senses.definitionEn: something that causes difficulty or that needs to be dealt with

examples.en: We have a problem with the internet connection.
examples.noteTr: have a problem with: ... ile ilgili sorunu olmak.

examples.en: Thanks for your help! No problem.
Can you solve this maths problem?

commonMistakesTr: "every" tekil isimle kullanılır: every student ("every students" değil).
grammarNoteTr: every + tekil isim + tekil fiil

senses.label: all of a group
senses.definitionEn: each one of a group, with no exceptions

examples.en: I walk to work every day.
Every student needs a pencil for the test.
examples.tr: Her öğrencinin sınav için bir kurşun kaleme ihtiyacı var.

examples.en: She calls her mother every Sunday.

grammarNoteTr: start + -ing / to + fiil

senses.label: begin
senses.definitionEn: to begin doing something, or to make something begin

examples.en: What time does the film start?
I started learning English two years ago.
examples.tr: İki yıl önce İngilizce öğrenmeye başladım.

examples.en: My car won't start in cold weather.

senses.label: body part
senses.definitionEn: the part of your body at the end of your arm, with fingers and a thumb

examples.en: Wash your hands before you eat.
He writes with his left hand.
Can you give me a hand with these boxes?
examples.tr: Bu kutular için bana yardım edebilir misin?
examples.noteTr: give someone a hand: yardım etmek.

examples.en: On the other hand, the bigger flat is more expensive.
examples.tr: Öte yandan, daha büyük daire daha pahalı.
examples.noteTr: on the other hand: öte yandan.

commonMistakesTr: "might"tan sonra "to" gelmez: "It might to rain" değil "It might rain" denir.
grammarNoteTr: might + yalın fiil: zayıf olasılık

senses.label: possibility
senses.definitionEn: used to say that something is possible but not certain

examples.en: I might go to the gym after work.
Take a jacket; it might get cold later.
examples.tr: Bir ceket al; sonra hava soğuyabilir.

examples.en: She might not come to the party.

grammarNoteTr: show + kişi + şey; show – showed – shown

senses.label: let someone see
senses.definitionEn: to let someone see something, or to explain how to do something

examples.en: Can you show me your photos from the trip?
The guide showed us the old part of the city.
examples.tr: Rehber bize şehrin eski kısmını gösterdi.

examples.en: This chart shows how prices have changed.
examples.tr: Bu grafik fiyatların nasıl değiştiğini gösteriyor.

commonMistakesTr: "take part" (katılmak) kalıbında "in" kullanılır: take part in a race ("take part to" değil).

senses.label: piece of a whole
senses.definitionEn: one piece or section of something larger

examples.en: The first part of the book is a bit slow.
examples.tr: Kitabın ilk kısmı biraz yavaş ilerliyor.

examples.en: Which part of the city do you live in?
Over two hundred runners took part in the race.
examples.tr: İki yüzden fazla koşucu yarışa katıldı.

senses.label: opposing
senses.definitionEn: opposing or competing with someone or something

examples.en: We played against a very strong team.
examples.tr: Çok güçlü bir takıma karşı oynadık.

examples.en: Most people are against the new parking rules.
examples.tr: Çoğu insan yeni park kurallarına karşı.

examples.en: Stealing is against the law.

senses.label: touching
senses.definitionEn: touching something for support

examples.en: He leaned his bike against the wall.
She stood with her back against the door.

senses.label: area or position
senses.definitionEn: a particular area, building or position

examples.en: This is a nice place for a picnic.
examples.tr: Burası piknik için güzel bir yer.

examples.en: The meeting will take place on Monday.
Do you want to come to my place after class?
examples.tr: Dersten sonra bize gelmek ister misin?

commonMistakesTr: "such" tekil sayılabilir isimle "a" alır: such a nice day ("such nice day" değil).
grammarNoteTr: such a + sıfat + tekil isim; such as: gibi, örneğin

senses.label: of this kind or degree
senses.definitionEn: used to give emphasis, or to talk about things of a kind already mentioned

examples.en: It was such a beautiful day.
I love fruit such as apples and pears.
examples.tr: Elma ve armut gibi meyveleri çok severim.

examples.en: I've never heard such a strange story.
examples.tr: Hiç böyle tuhaf bir hikâye duymadım.

senses.label: one more time
senses.definitionEn: one more time, or another time

examples.en: Can you say that again, please?
I failed the test, so I have to take it again.
examples.tr: Sınavdan kaldım, o yüzden tekrar girmem gerekiyor.

examples.en: It's nice to see you again!

commonMistakesTr: "a few" (birkaç, olumlu) ile "few" (çok az, olumsuz anlam) karıştırılır.
grammarNoteTr: (a) few + sayılabilir çoğul isim

senses.label: small number
senses.definitionEn: a small number of

examples.en: I'll be ready in a few minutes.
Very few people came to the meeting.
We stayed in Rome for a few days.

senses.label: situation
senses.definitionEn: a particular situation or example of something

examples.en: In that case, we'll meet tomorrow instead.
Take an umbrella in case it rains.
In some cases, students can take the exam again.
examples.tr: Bazı durumlarda öğrenciler sınava tekrar girebilir.

senses.label: container
senses.definitionEn: a container or cover for holding or protecting something

examples.en: I need a new case for my phone.
examples.tr: Telefonum için yeni bir kılıf lazım.

examples.en: She put her glasses back in their case.

senses.label: seven days
senses.definitionEn: a period of seven days

examples.en: I go swimming twice a week.
examples.noteTr: twice a week: haftada iki kez.

examples.en: We're going on holiday next week.
The course lasts six weeks.

senses.label: business
senses.definitionEn: an organization that sells goods or services to make money

examples.en: She works for a large software company.
examples.noteTr: work for a company: bir şirkette çalışmak.

examples.en: The company opened a new office in Izmir.
examples.tr: Şirket İzmir'de yeni bir ofis açtı.

examples.en: How many people work at your company?

senses.label: organized set of parts or methods
senses.definitionEn: a set of connected parts, or a way of doing things, that work together

examples.en: The city has a very good transport system.
examples.tr: Şehrin çok iyi bir ulaşım sistemi var.

examples.en: Our computer system was down all morning.
Many people want to change the education system.
examples.tr: Birçok insan eğitim sistemini değiştirmek istiyor.

grammarNoteTr: each + tekil isim; each of + çoğul isim; each other: birbirini

senses.label: every one separately
senses.definitionEn: every one of two or more things, considered separately

examples.en: Each room has its own bathroom.
The tickets cost ten euros each.
The two sisters help each other a lot.
examples.tr: İki kız kardeş birbirine çok yardım ediyor.

senses.label: correct
senses.definitionEn: correct or true

examples.en: Is this the right way to the station?
examples.tr: İstasyona giden doğru yol bu mu?

examples.en: You're right, I made a mistake.
Did I give the right answer?

senses.label: direction
senses.definitionEn: on or toward the side of your body that is to the east when you face north

examples.en: Turn right after the bank.
She broke her right arm last winter.

grammarNoteTr: İngiliz İngilizcesinde televizyon programı için "programme" yazılır

senses.label: show, plan or software
senses.definitionEn: a show on TV or radio, a plan of activities, or a set of instructions for a computer

examples.en: My favorite TV program starts at eight.
examples.tr: En sevdiğim televizyon programı sekizde başlıyor.

examples.en: She is taking a summer program in Spain.
You need a special program to open this file.
examples.tr: Bu dosyayı açmak için özel bir programa ihtiyacın var.

commonMistakesTr: "hear" (duymak) ile "listen" (dinlemek) karıştırılır: I heard a noise / I listen to music.
grammarNoteTr: hear – heard – heard

senses.label: notice sounds
senses.definitionEn: to notice sounds with your ears

examples.en: Can you hear me now?
I heard a strange noise last night.
examples.tr: Dün gece garip bir ses duydum.

examples.en: Have you heard about the new café on our street?

commonMistakesTr: "Soru sormak" için "make a question" değil "ask a question" denir.
grammarNoteTr: ask a question ("make" değil)

senses.label: something you ask
senses.definitionEn: a sentence or phrase that asks for information

examples.en: May I ask you a personal question?
examples.tr: Size kişisel bir soru sorabilir miyim?

examples.en: I couldn't answer the last question on the exam.
That's a good question, let me think.
examples.tr: Bu iyi bir soru, bir düşüneyim.

commonMistakesTr: "during"den sonra cümle gelmez: during the film ("during I watched" değil); cümle için "while" kullanılır.
grammarNoteTr: during + isim

senses.label: throughout a period
senses.definitionEn: throughout a period of time, or at some point in it

examples.en: Please turn off your phones during the film.
I worked in a café during the summer holidays.
Did anything happen during the meeting?
examples.tr: Toplantı sırasında bir şey oldu mu?

commonMistakesTr: Spor için "play football" ("the" yok), müzik aleti için "play the guitar" ("the" var) denir.
grammarNoteTr: play + spor; play the + çalgı

senses.label: games and sports
senses.definitionEn: to take part in a game or sport, or to have fun

examples.en: The kids are playing in the garden.
Do you want to play football after school?
examples.tr: Okuldan sonra futbol oynamak ister misin?

examples.en: We played cards until midnight.

senses.label: music
senses.definitionEn: to make music with an instrument, or to make a recording produce sound

examples.en: My brother plays the piano very well.
examples.tr: Erkek kardeşim çok iyi piyano çalar.

examples.en: The radio was playing an old song.

senses.label: not large
senses.definitionEn: little in size, number or amount

examples.en: We live in a small village by the sea.
examples.tr: Deniz kenarında küçük bir köyde yaşıyoruz.

examples.en: These jeans are too small for me now.
examples.tr: Bu kot pantolon artık bana çok küçük.

examples.en: She runs a small business from home.

commonMistakesTr: "a number of" çoğul isim ve çoğul fiil alır: A number of students are absent.

senses.label: figure
senses.definitionEn: a word or symbol such as 1, 2 or 3, or a group of these used to identify something

examples.en: Can I have your phone number?
Choose a number between one and ten.
examples.tr: Bir ile on arasında bir sayı seç.

examples.en: A large number of tourists visit the city every year.
examples.tr: Her yıl çok sayıda turist şehri ziyaret ediyor.

commonMistakesTr: "Işığı kapatmak" için "close the light" değil "turn off the light" denir.
grammarNoteTr: Fiil + off: turn off (kapatmak), take off (çıkarmak; havalanmak)

senses.label: away or not operating
senses.definitionEn: away from a place or surface, or not working or operating

examples.en: Please turn off the TV before you go to bed.
Take your shoes off at the door.
I'm taking Friday off to visit my parents.
examples.tr: Ailemi ziyaret etmek için cuma günü izin alıyorum.
examples.noteTr: take a day off: izin almak.

commonMistakesTr: "always" genelde ana fiilden önce gelir: I always drink tea ("I drink always tea" değil).
grammarNoteTr: always + ana fiil; be + always

senses.label: at all times
senses.definitionEn: at all times, or every time

examples.en: I always drink tea in the morning.
She is always late for class.
You can always ask me for help.

commonMistakesTr: "İzmir'e taşındık" için "We moved in Izmir" değil "We moved to Izmir" denir.

senses.label: change place
senses.definitionEn: to change position, or to go to live in a different place

examples.en: We moved to a bigger flat last year.
examples.tr: Geçen yıl daha büyük bir daireye taşındık.

examples.en: Don't move, there's a bee on your arm!
Can you help me move this table?
examples.tr: Bu masayı taşımama yardım edebilir misin?

commonMistakesTr: "Geceleri" için "in the night" yerine genelde "at night" kullanılır.

senses.label: dark part of the day
senses.definitionEn: the time when it is dark and most people sleep

examples.en: I can't sleep at night when it's hot.
We stayed up all night talking.
Good night, see you in the morning!

commonMistakesTr: "Nerede yaşıyorsun?" için "Where are you living in?" yerine "Where do you live?" denir.
grammarNoteTr: live in + şehir/ülke; live at + adres

senses.label: have your home or be alive
senses.definitionEn: to have your home somewhere, or to be alive

examples.en: My cousins live in Germany.
She lives with two friends near the university.
Some turtles live for over a hundred years.
examples.tr: Bazı kaplumbağalar yüz yıldan fazla yaşar.

senses.label: idea or opinion
senses.definitionEn: an idea, opinion or fact that someone says or writes

examples.en: That's a good point; I hadn't thought of it.
What's the point of waiting here?
examples.noteTr: What's the point of...?: ...in ne anlamı var?

examples.en: From my point of view, the plan is too risky.
examples.tr: Benim bakış açıma göre plan fazla riskli.

senses.label: score
senses.definitionEn: a unit used to count the score in a game or competition

examples.en: Our team won by three points.
You get ten points for each correct answer.
examples.tr: Her doğru cevap için on puan alırsın.

commonMistakesTr: "believe" ile "believe in" farklıdır: I believe you (doğru söylediğine inanıyorum) / I believe in you (sana güveniyorum).

senses.label: think something is true
senses.definitionEn: to think that something is true or that someone is telling the truth

examples.en: I can't believe it's already October!
Nobody believed his strange story.
Do you believe in luck?

grammarNoteTr: hold – held – held; hold on: beklemek

senses.label: have in your hands
senses.definitionEn: to have something in your hand or arms

examples.en: Can you hold my coffee for a second?
The little girl held her father's hand.
Hold on a minute, I'll get a pen.
examples.tr: Bir dakika bekle, bir kalem alayım.

senses.label: organize an event
senses.definitionEn: to have a meeting, party or other event

examples.en: The school holds a concert every spring.
examples.tr: Okul her bahar bir konser düzenler.

examples.en: The meeting will be held in room twelve.
examples.tr: Toplantı on iki numaralı odada yapılacak.

commonMistakesTr: "today" önüne "in" ya da "at" gelmez: I'm busy today.

senses.label: this day
senses.definitionEn: on this day, or at the present time

examples.en: What are you doing today?
I'm very busy today, so let's meet tomorrow.
Today, most people pay by card.
examples.tr: Günümüzde çoğu insan kartla ödeme yapıyor.

commonMistakesTr: "bring" (buraya getirmek) ile "take" (oraya götürmek) karıştırılır.
grammarNoteTr: bring – brought – brought

senses.label: carry here
senses.definitionEn: to take something or someone with you to the place where you are going or where the speaker is

examples.en: Can you bring me a glass of water?
examples.tr: Bana bir bardak su getirebilir misin?

examples.en: Don't forget to bring your passport.
She brought a cake to the party.

commonMistakesTr: "Ne oldu?" için "What was happened?" değil "What happened?" denir; happen edilgen yapılmaz.
grammarNoteTr: happen to + kişi: birinin başına gelmek

senses.label: take place
senses.definitionEn: to take place, especially without being planned

examples.en: What happened to your arm?
The accident happened near the bridge.
Don't worry, it won't happen again.

commonMistakesTr: "Gelecek hafta" için "the next week" değil "next week" denir; "in" de kullanılmaz.

senses.label: coming after
senses.definitionEn: coming immediately after this one in time or order

examples.en: See you next week at the same time!
The next train leaves at six.
Who sits next to you in class?

grammarNoteTr: without + isim / -ing

senses.label: not having
senses.definitionEn: not having, using or doing something

examples.en: I can't drink coffee without sugar.
He left without saying goodbye.
We can't finish the project without your help.

commonMistakesTr: "İki gün önce" için "two days before" değil "two days ago" denir; "before" bir olaydan önceyi anlatır: before dinner.
grammarNoteTr: before + isim / -ing / cümle

senses.label: earlier than
senses.definitionEn: earlier than a time or event

examples.en: Brush your teeth before bed.
I always check my email before starting work.
examples.tr: İşe başlamadan önce her zaman e-postalarımı kontrol ederim.

examples.en: Have you been here before?

senses.label: big
senses.definitionEn: bigger than usual in size or amount

examples.en: Can I have a large coffee, please?
examples.tr: Büyük boy bir kahve alabilir miyim, lütfen?

examples.en: They live in a large house outside the city.
examples.tr: Şehrin dışında büyük bir evde oturuyorlar.

examples.en: A large amount of plastic ends up in the sea.
examples.noteTr: a large amount of: büyük miktarda.

commonMistakesTr: Sayıdan sonra "million" çoğul eki almaz: three million people ("three millions" değil).
grammarNoteTr: sayı + million (-s yok); millions of: milyonlarca

senses.definitionEn: the number 1,000,000

examples.en: The city has about two million people.
examples.tr: Şehirde yaklaşık iki milyon kişi yaşıyor.

examples.en: Millions of people watched the final on TV.
The new bridge cost forty million dollars.
examples.tr: Yeni köprü kırk milyon dolara mal oldu.

commonMistakesTr: "must not" (yasak) ile "don't have to" (gerek yok) karıştırılır.
grammarNoteTr: must + yalın fiil; mustn't: yasak

senses.label: necessity
senses.definitionEn: used to say that something is necessary or very important to do

examples.en: You must wear a seat belt in the car.
Students must not use phones during the exam.
I must remember to call my grandmother.

commonMistakesTr: "Eve gitmek" için "go to home" değil "go home" denir.
grammarNoteTr: go/come home: "to" kullanılmaz; at home: evde

senses.label: where you live
senses.definitionEn: the place where you live

examples.en: I'm going home now, I'm really tired.
Is anyone at home right now?
examples.tr: Şu an evde kimse var mı?

examples.en: There's no place like home.
